an3.3:1.1: “Bhikkhus, the fool has these three characteristics of a fool, marks of a fool, manifestations of a fool.
an3.3:1.3: Here, a fool thinks badly, speaks badly, and acts badly.
an3.3:1.4: If the fool did not think badly, speak badly, and act badly, how would wise people know of him:
an3.3:1.5: ‘This fellow is a fool, a bad person’?
an3.3:1.6: But because the fool thinks badly, speaks badly, and acts badly, wise people know of him:
an3.3:1.7: ‘This fellow is a fool, a bad person.’
an3.3:1.8: These are the fool’s three characteristics of a fool, marks of a fool, manifestations of a fool.
an3.3:2.1: “The wise person has these three characteristics of a wise person, marks of a wise person, manifestations of a wise person.
an3.3:2.3: Here, a wise person thinks well, speaks well, and acts well.
an3.3:2.4: If the wise person did not think well, speak well, and act well, how would wise people know of him:
an3.3:2.5: ‘This fellow is wise, a good person’?
an3.3:2.6: But because the wise person thinks well, speaks well, and acts well, wise people know of him:
an3.3:2.7: ‘This fellow is wise, a good person.’
an3.3:2.8: These are the wise person’s three characteristics of a wise person, marks of a wise person, manifestations of a wise person.
an3.3:2.9: “Therefore … as in 3:2 … It is in this way that you should train yourselves.”
